desc: Official recommended settings: OpenAI's recommended sampling settings for the two gpt-oss sizes (transcribed on 2026-08-20 from the unsloth doc gpt-oss-how-to-run-and-fine-tune page, section 'Recommended Settings' -- values only, unsloth itself is not used): temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=0, min_p=0.0; checked against the vLLM SamplingParams docs, top_k=0 (= unlimited) and min_p=0.0 are exactly vLLM's factory defaults, and the model directory's generation_config.json does not set sampling fields either, so leaving these two out of the preset keys and not passing them from any entry point is equivalent; effort takes the official harmony template default, medium; the official recommendation is a minimum context of 16384 and a maximum of 131072, so server.max_model_len is pinned to 131072 (matches the H100 example on the vLLM gpt-oss recipe page); max_tokens is not given in the docs, left null to fall back to the caller's default; api is unspecified, following the caller; seed stays null (sampling differs each time at temperature=1.0; open a separate preset with a seed to reproduce); the rest of the server section follows the collection line's server launch settings: tokyo108:8103, GPU memory 0.92
